item.text: The evaluation code currently lives in `storage/rule.go`, and its rule collection uses a map, which loses rank order. I’m moving that code into `EvaluatorStorage` and preserving query order when selecting the first matching rule.

func TestEvaluatorRankAndResponseMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	flag, err := flagStore.CreateFlag(ctx, &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name(), Enabled: true})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	first, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name() + \"_first\", Name: \"first\"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name() + \"_second\", Name: \"second\"})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Both rules match. Rank, rather than map iteration order, determines the segment.
	_, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: second.Key, Rank: 2})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: first.Key, Rank: 1})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	requestContext := map[string]string{\"region\": \"west\"}
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		resp, err := evaluatorStore.Evaluate(ctx, &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, EntityId: \"entity\", Context: requestContext})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.True(t, resp.Match)
		assert.Equal(t, first.Key, resp.SegmentKey)
		assert.Empty(t, resp.Value)
		assert.Equal(t, requestContext, resp.RequestContext)
		assert.NotEmpty(t, resp.RequestId)
		require.NotNil(t, resp.Timestamp)
	}
}

func TestEvaluatorComparisonNormalizationAndErrors(t *testing.T) {
	assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \" EQ \", Value: \"  alpha  \"}, \" alpha \"))
	assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"PREFIX\", Value: \" al \"}, \" alpha \"))
	assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"suffix\", Value: \" ha \"}, \" alpha \"))
	assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"EMPTY\"}, \"  \"))
	assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"NOTEMPTY\"}, \" x \"))

	match, err := matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"GTE\", Value: \" 3.5 \"}, \" 3.5 \")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, match)
	_, err = matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"eq\", Value: \"3\"}, \"not-a-number\")
	require.Error(t, err)
	_, err = matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"eq\", Value: \"NaN\"}, \"3\")
	require.Error(t, err)

	match, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TRUE\"}, \" True \")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, match)
	_, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"false\"}, \"not-a-boolean\")
	require.Error(t, err)

	for _, op := range []string{\"empty\", \"notempty\", \"true\", \"false\", \"present\", \"notpresent\"} {
		assert.NoError(t, validate(constraint{Property: \"p\", Operator: op}), op)
	}
	assert.Error(t, validate(constraint{Property: \"p\", Operator: \"eq\"}))
}

func TestEvaluatorHashCutoffIsInclusive(t *testing.T) {
	const flagKey = \"hash-boundary\"
	var atCutoff, afterCutoff string
	for i := 0; i < 100000 && (atCutoff == \"\" || afterCutoff == \"\"); i++ {
		entityID := fmt.Sprintf(\"entity-%d\", i)
		switch crc32Num(entityID, flagKey) {
		case 500:
			atCutoff = entityID
		case 501:
			afterCutoff = entityID
		}
	}
	require.NotEmpty(t, atCutoff)
	require.NotEmpty(t, afterCutoff)
	distributions := []distribution{{VariantKey: \"first\"}, {VariantKey: \"second\"}}
	for _, tt := range []struct{ entityID, want string }{{atCutoff, \"first\"}, {afterCutoff, \"second\"}} {
		match, got := evaluate(&flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: flagKey, EntityId: tt.entityID}, distributions, []int{500, 1000})
		assert.True(t, match)
		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got.VariantKey)
	}
}
